title: Top Tool Sets for First Apartments & Garages (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products from Good Housekeeping, TechGearLab, and Popular Mechanics reviews, choosing the one with the strongest build quality and widest tool range.
assumptions: Prices are not listed in the sources, so no price information is provided.

verdict.line: If you need a solid set of hand tools for furniture assembly and everyday fixes, the Craftsman 102‑Piece set offers high‑quality screwdrivers, pliers, a hammer, and a socket set in a durable case. It wins because its build quality is the highest among the picks, but it is heavier than some other kits.
